pins.title: 24 Hours in Irvington, Virginia: A Day Trip Guide
pins.description: 24 hours in Irvington on Virginia's Northern Neck: the Saturday farmers market, the Steamboat Era Museum, a vineyard behind a 19th-century schoolhouse, dinner on Carter's Creek.
pins.altText: Aerial view of a waterfront cottage and creek on Virginia's Northern Neck at dusk.

pins.title: Irvington VA: Tides Inn, Farmers Market, and the Vineyard
pins.description: What to do in Irvington, Virginia: the Tides Inn for a drink even if you are not staying, the Saturday market, the Dog and Oyster vineyard, and where to eat nearby.
pins.altText: Golden hour on a Northern Neck creek, dock and treeline in view.

pins.title: The Prettiest Small Town on Virginia's Northern Neck
pins.description: Irvington is the refined counterweight to Reedville's working waterfront: two nationally known inns, a steamboat museum, and a vineyard, in a town of a few hundred people.
pins.altText: A waterfront cottage at dusk seen from the air, Virginia's Northern Neck.
